notes.title: Academia: School Simulator joins Paradox interactive!
notes.content:
Paradox Interactive revealed it acquired Academia: School Simulator from Squeaky Wheel Studio. The latest addition to the publisher's growing management portfolio is a cheerful, yet challenging, title that tasks players with building and managing a high school. Academia: School Simulator was created by Philippine game development studio Squeaky Wheel under the leadership of former CEO Ryan Sumo, who was also the artist behind Prison Architect's iconic art style. 

"I'm excited about this new step for Academia,” says Ryan Sumo. “It took us nine months to launch it in Early Access, and since its release in 2017, we've been overwhelmed by the positive reviews and the support from the community. Academia: School Simulator will always hold a special place in the hearts of myself and my former coworkers at Squeaky Wheel. And thanks to Paradox, more people will get to discover our labor of love. I hope everybody will enjoy the game: can't wait to see some new students running down the hallways!”

notes.title: Academia Final Update (Build 1.0.27)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30448709/a1d796874d602e28537ccf620b23a46563f6f5bc.jpg[/img]
Hello scholars, 

We’re back with our final update this month, bringing you bug fixes, lew languages, and quality of life improvements.

[h3]Built-In Languages[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30448709/c0dd3200f5636a1659fdd5aa4586e0743ff683ff.gif[/img]
First of all, we now have built-in languages for 12 different languages! Instead of having to look for mod, speakers of these languages can just click to change to their language of choice. It was really cool working with a lot of different languages and we learned so much through the localization process.

For other languages, you can still check the mods to see if your language is available!

[h3]Bugs Fixed and Quality of Live Improvements[/h3]
There were a lot of bugs introduced by the Version 1 build, and we’re sorry about some of the worst ones you folks experienced. We put out hotfix after hotfix and feel the game is now much more stable. Thanks to everyone who sent in bug reports, and once again we’re very sorry you all experienced this. Lots of little fixes here and there based on suggestions from players and localizers. Some of our favorite QoL improvements are below.

[h3]Student Roster Searching and End of Year Favorites[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30448709/3dbf27e8abb9732898af5498ec402c70c09a8963.gif[/img]
We now have searchable student rosters in the game so you can more easily find your favorite students. You can search for students in the end of year exams now, as well as favorite them in the end of year as well.

[h3]Flagpoles can use Different Flags[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30448709/683e319e94cfa322a4a321c40652eca086bb4435.gif[/img]
A nice little visual treat, you can now use different flags per flagpole, in case you want to make your own little United Nations type school. We’ve also improved the functionality for searching for flags. It now comes with a searchable panel, and a preview of the flag.

[h3]New Hotkeys[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30448709/3279b5ae218177f14ba6fc31cd8f77a3f8165784.png[/img]
We added new hotkeys after requests from our veteran players to be able to access some common commands.

[h3]New Animations and Particle Effects[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30448709/754fe13f38cd529271f6795f1ac6355866ab327f.gif[/img]
We have a lot of juicy new particle effects that give that tiny extra level of immersion and delight when playing the game. I just love the little smoke puffs when the workers build stuff.

[h3]Sandbox Mode Changes[/h3]
You can now start out with all students in Sandbox Mode. For those architects who just want to build out the school of their dreams and cram it full of students, now you can! Fair warning though, the game time does slow down the more students there are (this is to accommodate all the decisions the AI is making) so the days will pass by slower if you fill up the school right away.

[h3]Added New Objects Mods[/h3]
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2428147093&searchtext=
You can now add new objects as mods. This was also a player request that we decided to implement. You can add up to 5 each of 1x1, 1x2, 2x1, and 2x2 objects. These objects will be purely decorative, and will not cost anything. you can see a sample "skeleton" mod I made above. Find out more about how to do that [url=http://174.138.17.250/index.php/How_to_edit_hidden_objects_(or_how_to_have_new_objects_using_the_hidden_objects)%3F]here[/url].

[h3]That’s All for Now Folks[/h3]
This marks the end of active development for Academia : School Simulator. While we will be monitoring our bug reports and attending to major issues, we’re going to be taking what I believe is a well deserved break from this point on. We want to thank everyone who has worked on, played, and reviewed the game. We could not have done it without all of you!

notes.title: Academia : School Simulator Version 1 Release!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30448709/29aa371f452a4c6114b37b8a9c07e4e0a12afbe5.gif[/img]

Hello Scholars, 

It’s finally graduation day! After 4 years in development and 3 years in Early Access, Academia : School Simulator is finally in version 1. Thanks so much to everyone who supported us along the way, and to our community that gave us feedback, reported bugs, and made awesome mods for the game. So what’s in store for you in Version 1.

[h3]Hardcore Mode[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30448709/3ad69593d9219ab7fb4b35e247f99b8317004bb2.gif[/img]
We like cozy games as much as anyone, but some of our players find the game TOO EASY. To satisfy those seeking a challenge, we’ve added a new difficulty mode.

BONUS: We also added these informative icons that change when you pick the settings, hopefully this makes things easier to read!

[h3]New Events[/h3]
We’ve added events that will make you laugh, we’ve added one event that may make you cry. We’ve also added events where certain options are unlocked by a special principal or by other unique choices you have made at your school.

[h3]New Grants and Achievements[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30448709/3537cb3e9c592819af728b217894894eca102d51.gif[/img]
New Grants and Achievements will give you something to aim for in the late game.

[h3]New Scenarios[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30448709/08ca317c79629cb8fa85ee852b3914492eee2e1e.gif[/img]
Take care of dyslexic students or build a school in a disaster area with limited space? We have 3 more scenarios to challenge you.

[h3]A Proper Tutorial[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30448709/211d5ea91ee6b409b62f178b9e181cf834f2a2e0.gif[/img]
While many of our scholars are already Seniors, we know that over the years Freshmen players have been struggling with some aspects of the game.  We wanted to make sure that our Freshmen have all the help they need with version 1 so we made this tutorial a priority!

[h3]Bugfixes and UI Improvements[/h3]
We won’t list them here as we normally do, but rest assured that many little improvements have been made in order create a better play experience. We will continue to fix these bugs even after the launch so keep sending those reports in.

[h3]What’s Next?[/h3]
As mentioned before we will be focusing on bugfixing. We may also add some more mod functionality as well as some cosmetic updates to the game (more hairstyles, etc). But our main focus will be on working on a console release for the game, as well as adding localization so even more people can enjoy the game in their native language. Beyond that, you’ll just have to wait and see. 

We’ll also be announcing the winners of our Academia Challenge Coins soon!

[h3]Thanks So Much From The Squeaky Wheel Team[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30448709/9aa30f49c2025e134659d450879ddaf799960a3e.png[/img]

Core Squeaky Wheel Team, from left : JM,  Neil, Marica, Marnel, Ryan, Tristan.

I know everyone says this, but we’d really like to give a heartfelt thank you to all of our players for cheering us on and helping to make the game better. The picture above is of the Squeaky Wheel core team. It was taken in October 2019 to celebrate our 4 year anniversary party, which we celebrated with a bunch of other Filipino game developers. It’s amazing to think that it’s been almost a year since we last saw each other in real life, and that we finished the game in that time.

Thanks again for coming along for the ride folks, we couldn’t have done it without you!

notes.title: Version 1 Arriving in 2 Week + Challenge Coins!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30448709/401b53940c2db37f28ce93c2ac3b0a6b0d740f16.jpg[/img]
Hello Scholars,

Aren’t these Academia Challenge coins cool? Well I certainly think so. But we’ll talk more about those later.

We’re currently busy fighting a horde of bugs and making last minute improvements to Academia : School Simulator for our [url=https://youtu.be/_VF0rfngTm0]version 1 launch[/url]. Academia will have its version 1 launch on January 28. This means we will have been at work on Academia for 4 years at this point. Especially given the crazy year that 2020 was, this feels like a lifetime. To see how the game has grown since over the years, check out these videos:

[url=https://youtu.be/-vXKu7KnwSU]New Game Devlog Pre-Alpha 1 Feb 13, 2017[/url]

[url=https://youtu.be/YSyan86tS7w]Academia : School Simulator Dev Blog 6 Sep 1, 2017[/url]

[url=https://youtu.be/NPJzJJUcDHo]Academia : School Simulator Dev Blog 9 Mar 9, 2018[/url]

We hope you enjoyed that little trip down memory lane, but now it’s time to discuss what’s next.

[h3]What’s Next?[/h3]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/672630/view/2925614021638790834]As mentioned before[/url], the Version 1 update will be coming with new Events, Scenarios, Achievements, and Grants to keep you all occupied and entertained.

We are also planning on adding localizations for many languages so that more people can enjoy playing the game.

However, the launch of Version 1 does mean the end of any major updates to the game. That means any suggestion made from this point on will likely not make it into Version 1. We will mostly be focused on more bugfixing and UI updates to improve the game experience. We may also add some visual updates. We also hope to add additional modding options so that folks can make more and better additions to the game.

This is a tough call, but we had to make a decision on when to stop developing the game, and ultimately the team decided this was a good stopping point.

We may add on to the game via DLC, but that will probably not come anytime soon. We’re also hoping to do a console port. We know that some of you will be disappointed with this news, but we hope that the 4 years of hard work our small team has put into the game will entertain you for many more hours to come.

[h3]What about Those Coins?[/h3]

Challenge coins are a cool way to commemorate things that can’t be touched like digital games, and these coins have made their way into the hands of our game developer friends as a way to thank them for their support and friendship.

And now we’d love to share them with some of our players. We won’t be able to see you at conventions anymore, but we can still mail these coins out to you!  We’ll be mailing 20 of these coins to our players, free of charge, as a thank you for all the support for the past four years.

notes.title: Academia : School Simulator Graduates out of Early Access Next Year!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=_VF0rfngTm0;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello scholars, 

We have some exciting news for all of you. After four years of development, we're finally ready to graduate out of Early Access! With your feedback and support, Academia : School Simulator has become the best school simulator game on Steam with an astonishing 98% positive (fingers crossed we keep this up) in recent reviews. The game has been enjoyed by more than 80000 people around the world, playing and sharing their schools and making mods for the game. We prepared an announcement trailer specifically for this occasion. If you like it please do us a favor and like the video and share it on social media.

So what's in store for you in version 1?

First off, we have another major update coming in December called "Teacher's Pet." This update was inspired by our players who grew attached to their students during their play sessions.  The update will let you select favorite students to keep track of, and let you encourage or discipline them individually. It will add a student roster UI, and will the best students will also be added to the honor roll list at the end of the school year.

For version 1 we will be adding a proper tutorial! We'll also be adding more grants, achievements, events, and scenarios to round out the game. We will also be doing the usual UI fixes and polish that accompany our major releases. We're looking forward to adding more languages so that more people can play the game. Lastly, we'll also be adding an insane difficulty mode for the few folks who feel that the game is too easy!

After version 1 we'll be taking a break while still keeping an eye on the bug reports to make sure that any major issues are fixed as soon as possible.

We also want to take this opportunity to announce that we will be raising the price of the game at some point this month. This was the plan all along, and this is our way of thanking everyone that participated in the Early Access process with us since we launched in Early Access in 2017.

Thanks again for the support everyone, we couldn't have done it without you!

4) Enter the beta access code to unlock private betas type (see the list of branches below to know what code to enter)

notes.title: Academia Alpha 4 is Out!
notes.content:
Hello scholars,

We’re excited to announce that after almost a year since Alpha 3, we are releasing Academia : School Simulator Alpha 4!  This marks a ton of development since Alpha 3, but first let’s go over what’s new since our last update.

[h3]Teacher Traits[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30448709/094d2e5d030be3a891633c9df5ca710610b479cc.gif[/img]
Teachers now have specific traits that affect their classes.  Will you choose a knowledgeable but super strict teacher or one that is not as smart but knows how to make their class fun? This provides even more challenge when selecting the best teacher!

[h3]More School Customization[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30448709/f77de1c4a93c16b3fedf65625e4a8f73c0552048.gif[/img]
You can now customize the school even more to create a specific challenge for yourself!  Will you start a school for rich kids or low income kids?  Are you up to the challenge of starting a school with a neighborhood with lots of goons?  Will you choose advanced students over those that have struggled with their classes?  It’s all up to you!

[h3]Edit Zone Names and Updated Zone Detail Panels[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30448709/87b1edd9c481127f75e09ee8b784abaab33673f6.gif[/img]
We changed how the edit zone panel details work for a better user experience, and also added a way for you to personalize the name of each zone. You can even name a toilet after your best frienemy!

[h3]Improved UI[/h3]
Each Alpha update aims to make the game more user friendly and polish up the UI. We have made numerous changes to improve the play experience for you and simply make the game look a little nicer.  Some of the UI changes include:

Updated School Creation Panel
Updated End of Year School Evaluation Panel
Updated HUD provides easy access to important information
Updated Todo List shows problems you need to address in your school like broken objects

[h3]Clouds![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30448709/36785fcc1e8c2754a20290b8d239f7890074f0cf.gif[/img]
Yes it’s a little ridiculous to announce clouds, but they just look so cool I could zoom in and out all day!

For those that have been waiting to try the game since Alpha 3, here’ everything we’ve added to the game since last year!

[h3]Events[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30448709/8ea15818b59228ea5240ccaf3ff4ca3df6e2f866.gif[/img]
Events will appear randomly throughout the game to give you moral dilemmas, opportunities, or just happy events where your students tell you that you did a great job!

[h3]Sell School[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30448709/aeefcd4e961b54cf053f2a5f4411c03b58dc5320.jpg[/img]
When you feel like you have run your course with your current school, why not sell it and start fresh with a new principal, a harder difficulty, and a different school pet? Selling your school gives you a larger amount of money to start with, based on your school valuation.

[h3]Food Fight and Food Quality[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30448709/03d51934174baa2ad3765ee3bb5f5ab4b269ca58.gif[/img]
You can now adjust the quality of your food if you want to save money, or feed the students better food for better learning. And keep an eye out for your delinquents, because they may start a food fight!

[h3]Special Principals[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30448709/dd97c9d0c1ae90007a7ecd23293282411b7648e5.gif[/img]
Are you a Drill Sergeant, a Reverend, a Capitalist, or just a plain old hardworking principal? Choose a principal based on your personality and play style.

[h3]Buy Land[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30448709/c7005e302f5896174431dc9d89282b666a139399.gif[/img]
Hire an accountant and a lawyer to draw up the paperwork and buy new plots of land to expand your educational institution!

[h3]Water and Electricity Generation[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30448709/32b55b87779f4f65908ff6e70a6fef3eb3a443b7.gif[/img]
Utility costs getting you down? Become self sufficient by drawing water from the ground or harvesting energy from the sun! But be careful, these objects are very expensive and have a higher rate of breaking down.

[h3]Zone Linking[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30448709/9cb4c6a5f9d646f91c1d534af5939eeb94079b19.gif[/img]
You can now link certain zones to each other, to maximize efficiency! With Zone Linking you can now specify which classrooms will go to specific cafeterias and common rooms, as well as principals’ offices. We’ve also added links from kitchen to cafeteria, so you can more efficiently control your kitchen staff. 

[h3]Goons[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30448709/bdfa9669850bd887a929883055fdbf0f6ee2aab5.gif[/img]
Adding to the challenge in the game, the goons are a bunch of tough guys who hang around your school and turn your kids into delinquents! Chase them off on your own, or empower your monitor to do the dirty work for you.

[h3]New Lawyer and Vice Principal Staff[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30448709/7749301a9a8bb7b9fae5f213b89dbd79d2ccd233.jpg[/img]
We added the lawyer and vice principal staff to expand the options available to you.  The lawyer staff allows you to expel students and mass fire the other staff, and opens up different research trees.  The vice principal helps your principal manage the sheer number of delinquents in your school!

[h3]School Bus[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30448709/70baa39f2129ff9df82c9d2bcbddd427c193d525.gif[/img]
It’s tiring to walk all the way to school. Sign up your students for the schoolbus so they get to school well rested and ready to learn!

That’s only the major stuff, there’s a lot more other things that we’ve added since last year!  Thanks so much to all of our players for continuously giving us feedback and support throughout this Early Access process. We are slowly inching our way to the full release of the game, and we hope you look forward to the coming updates!

notes.title: Ruinarch Launch Moved to August
notes.content:
Hello Overlords,

While we initially promised a release date of May 2020, we’re sad to announce that we will be pushing back release by a few months, to August 2020.  Even though we’re pretty evil, it felt a little bit tone deaf to be releasing a game about ruining people’s lives while the world seemingly falls apart on us because of the covid-19 pandemic.

You won’t have to wait too long though, because we’re only moving the launch to August, by which point hopefully the world will be on the road to recovery (so we can wreck virtual worlds guilt-free).  We’ll take that extra time to add more polish and content to the game so that you’ll get a much better game upon release.

In the meantime to whet your appetite, check out this new and improved trailer we made! We hope it gets you as pumped up for Early Access release as we are!

[previewyoutube=7I_ByK6h1Ak;full][/previewyoutube]

That’s all from us for now, stay safe, stay indoors, and wash your hands!

notes.title: Eventful Days Update is Released! (Build 0.3.97)
notes.content:
Hello Scholars,

Our latest update is here, called Eventful Days! The biggest difference here is now you will experience random events!  Read more below to find out what’s in store for you.

[h1]Events[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30448709/8ea15818b59228ea5240ccaf3ff4ca3df6e2f866.gif[/img]
Every few days a random event will occur where you will have to make a decision.  You can ignore the event at the cost of prestige.  You can see a hint of what some of the events will be in the illustration we made, but we don’t wanna spoil too much! We hope you guys like the events we’ve made so far, but feel free to suggest some events that you think might be fun/interesting!

[h1]Sell School[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30448709/aeefcd4e961b54cf053f2a5f4411c03b58dc5320.jpg[/img]
This is a longtime request, you can now sell your school to start over with much more money.  The amount of money depends on your school valuation, which you can see in the reports screen. Restarting lets you pick your difficulty, school principal, school logo etc.

[h1]Automatically Kick Out Goons[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30448709/7e6d3e16eaff23b7624d2fdc7c66451170b9ef3b.jpg[/img]
For those that can’t be bothered to find the and kick out the goons, we added a research that takes care of it for you!

[h3]UI Updates[/h3]
As we build up to Alpha 4 release in April we are improving the UI bit by bit for a better experience.  Some of the stuff we’ve been doing include:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30448709/a645d4e0ed22ad4f9298bdf382c81c91108f5241.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] Updated Cashflow Panel (now shows number of objects, added icons for easier navigation)
[*] Decluttered settings menu and move some icons to the HUD for easier access
[*] Update the save and load panels (autosaves now show more useful info)
[*] Graphics settings in Settings Panel
[*] Those and a lot more small tweaks have been added to the UI.
[/list]

[h3]A note on character skin mods[/h3]

In this release, we changed how the character images are managed. They are now separate images such that they can be added to main atlas (a big image that collects the smaller images) that the rest of the game uses. We did it this way so that future character skin mods would no longer break whenever we have character related updates.

However, this means that all the current character skin mods like uniforms [b]would be broken[/b] until the mod developer fixes them. We're truly sorry for this. The game will not break when you've installed these mods. They just won't get applied since the images that needs to be replaced are now different.

We've also updated the [url=http://174.138.17.250/index.php/How_to_make_an_image_replace_or_a_reskin_mod%3F]reskin modding guide[/url] in light of this change.

[h3]Bugs and other Design Update[/h3]

One major thing we did with this build is that we temporarily removed the "Sell to the Grid" Research.  We know some of you have been using it as a "unlimited money" workaround, but that was never the intent.  We will be thinking about how we can add it again in a more sensible fashion in the next update.

notes.title: Four Years of Squeaky Wheel
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35884729/4df755604d0e695f008e9bc669d1703af28befd0.png[/img]

Four years ago on this month, Tristan, Marnel and I became officially registered as Squeaky Wheel Studio Inc.We’ll be taking a break today and having dinner with some of our gamedev friends to celebrate, but in the meantime let me take a walk down memory lane.

[h1]September 2015[/h1]

I am at EGX 2015 for the launch of Prison Architect.  The IVSoftware team have kindly flown me and my wife over to celebrate the launch, so I use this as a way to pitch our game Political Animals to publishers.  I meet Cliffski for the first time and pitch the game to him.  

Within a couple of days he offers me a publishing deal.  Anyone who has done a publishing deal before will know that this is an extraordinarily short amount of time to get a deal done.  It helps that we got along and Cliffski is a one-man show studio that answers to no one, but still.

[h1]October 2015[/h1]

After landing back in Manila I immediately set about establishing a company, which is not a trivial process in the Philippines.  I end up paying more than I probably needed to in order to have another company help me set up my company, such is life here. We are officially registered with the SEC by October 28, 2015

Funny aside, I had thought that we had incorporated on October the 15, which is why we are celebrating our anniversary today. :P

[h1]November 2016[/h1]

After almost a year of working nonstop on Political Animals and taking it to conventions like BICfest, TGS, and PAX, we release the game.  Even with all the advantages that we had, it is a flop. 

[h1]September 2017[/h1]

A mere 10 months later, we launch Academia : School Simulator in Early Access.  It succeeds well enough to save the company and we continue development of the game.

[h1]October 2019[/h1]

It has been a little over 2 years since Early Access launch, and 3 years since initial development of Academia.  We have hit many highs and lows, but the game continues to make enough income to support our team.

[h1]<October 2020[/h1]

This brings me to an announcement from the future.  At some point before October 2020, we want to launch version 1 of Academia : School Simulator.  The game has made major strides since it first came out.  While there is still more work to be done, we can finally see the finish line.  

Games like Academia : School Simulator are tricky things. While there is the potential to build on it infinitely, we believe we’re coming close to a point that we are personally satisfied with it.  Version 1 doesn’t necessarily mean the end of development, but it does mean a change of focus for the team. It’s been a long road, and we’re excited to slowly inch our way to something new, whatever that may be.

Spoiler Alert, we have some exciting news coming up soon, so stay tuned!

[h1]Thanks to Everyone[/h1]

We want to thank everyone that has supported us throughout this journey.  Thanks to everyone who has played the game (if you enjoyed your experience please write us a review because it really matters!).  Thanks to our partners, our parents and families for supporting us.  Thanks to our fellow devs, streamers, and publishers for supporting us, spreading the word, and putting your faith in us.  

We hope that you’ll stick around for the years to come!

notes.title: 32-bit support will be discontinued after Alpha 3
notes.content:
Hi Everyone, 

We wanted to share some news today that may disappoint some of you.  We have an update coming to the game soon, which will be our Alpha 3.  We wanted to let you know that the Alpha 3 update will be the last one with 32-bit support. I’m sure some of you will be disappointed, so we wanted to be honest and let you know why we are doing this.

32-bit systems have a limit of 2GB memory usage.  This means that we’ve been struggling to optimize the game for the past year, and have lost valuable development time in the process.  Given the fact that Steam’s own hardware surveys suggest that less than 2 percent of their users are on 32-bit systems, it’s hard to justify that additional time and effort.

This wasn’t an easy decision for us, and we wanted to make sure to support 32-bit at least up until Alpha 3, to guarantee any 32-bit players a more fully featured game than when we launched.  

Academia : School Simulator will continue development, and we hope that by the time we release version 1, you’ll have a 64-bit system to enjoy all the new features we will have released by then.

Thanks for all the support, and see you at the next update.

[b]NOTE:[/b] Part of the reason we delayed implementing this is because we had to update the orientation of objects to be consistent across the board.  This means that rotation of some objects in existing save files will change. The new rotations might also cause overlap with other existing objects so they may be removed. notes.title: Academia : School Simulator Roadmap
notes.content:
Hi everyone, while we've been busy at work on the game, the updates have slowed down a little bit, and we've noticed some people expressing concern about development.  Rest assured we are still fully developing the game, and we have quite a few plans in store for you.  We know we've not been as good as giving you guys a roadmap to look forward to, so here is a quick summary of what you can expect from us in the next few months.

[h1]Achievements[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448709/47107b645a23debd5e1d8e5e2b10fa1f3d7109a4.jpg[/img]

As mentioned before, we've been adding Achievements to the game.  This is currently in the testing phase, and assuming everything is working well, it should be out very soon.

[h1]More Research Items[/h1]

We're currently adding more research items, including some fun ones to give you even more options with how to upgrade your staff and your school.

[h1]Priority Building and Cleaning[/h1]

A very popular demand that we're happy to finally be able to release soon.

[h1]Student Admissions[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448709/30a29476c4e0e602831513d1019a027ff9cd3b14.jpg[/img]

Once this is implemented you'll now have a lot more control about how many students to accept at the start of the school year.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448709/93bfcf685bfb7831f355b8b9743393f79a6fbd47.jpg[/img]

Running out of cash? We're working in a way you can loan some money (but mind the interest!)

[h1]Student Relationships[/h1]

This is something we've put off for a while but are actively designing right now. Ideally we'll have this out by Valentine's Day!

[h1]Student Dropouts[/h1]

Some of you have been asking for more of a challenge, well here it is.  Soon, students will start dropping out if you manage your school poorly, meaning you lose revenue and prestige!

[h1]Room Templates[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448709/5437bac11eca7b66f799c4d6cd4137d98e034a15.jpg[/img]

[h1]Bigger Maps[/h1]

Another thing a lot of people have been demanding!

There is no fixed timeline for these features because we'll adjust them as necessary, but we wanted you guys to at least know what we're planning for the next few months.  We'll do another update like this in the future so that you can all be aware of what we've got planned.  That's it for now, back to work!

notes.title: Build 0.2.79 adds Optimization and more Reports
notes.content:
Hi everyone, we're back with an update for you guys.  This month's update is mostly based on optimizations and bug fixes, new stuff will be added next month.

[h1]Optimization[/h1]

Players on 32bit OSes have been encountering problems with the game because of memory issues.  We've spent this month focused on fixing those issues, and hopefully brings some optimization fixes to the rest of the game as well.  This optimization will render the game in half size for anyone with a 32bit OS, which is a compromise we have to do for older systems.  Anyone with newer computers or playing on a 64bit OS should still see the game in full resolution.

[h1]More Reports[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448709/964660850a78701ea27f9de3f101fa459368a03b.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Hotfix Update (0.2.36)
notes.content:
Hi all, here we are once again with a hotfix.  This latest one seems to be caused by a language setting in the OS (possibly Windows 10) called "Culture Info".  It affects certain things like decimal points. For example in English, decimal numbers are written as 1.95 (period). Whereas in German, it's 1,95 (comma). This is what caused a bunch of the wild issues, like students teleporting, the ground becoming empty, and the school crest becoming all white. To fix it we forced a specific culture info that works for all languages.

Long story short, this is another hotfix, and fingers crossed this will solve the major issues you guys are reporting.

[b]NOTE:[/b] This will not fix previously broken saves.  You will have to start a new one.  If you want to make sure that your save will be safe, you can take these steps:

1) start a new game
2) immediately save the game
3) close the game
4) restart the game
5) load your save

If everything looks normal, then your save is probably safe to keep playing. If it looks broken, please send us a bug report with that save file.

Apologies once again for the trouble folks!

notes.title: Another Apology and a Promise to do Better
notes.content:
Hey everyone, as I write this it is 1am and I am the last of the team to go to bed.  We have been fighting a losing battle with a number of bugs that have dogged us ever since we updated to 0.2.32.  

In the spirit of transparency we want to give you a fair warning, the current version of the game may have game breaking bugs. I want to share what happened and the decisions that we made so you understand how things went wrong.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448709/649ffde9a43e195e0d9606be856b4758f33e5566.jpg[/img]

June 22 : Summer Sale starts. We keep it cool, working on a fix for the "Broken Roads" bug and adding some new content. We give it to our QA freelancers for testing. So far, so good.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448709/635050f62d2c73f26487fce3e7c58ce62f45e7b9.gif[/img]

June 28 : After a lot of testing, we decide that build 0.2.32 is ready to push out to you guys. We celebrate, job well done!

June 29 : We hear reports of workers acting funny and games crashing. We look at the bug reports, isolate the issues, and issue a hotfix. We celebrate, job well done!

June 30 : Celebrated too soon. More bugs. We are concerned. We have to make a choice. Should we roll back to  0.2.27? Looking at bug reports, it seems that there were still crash bugs, and that was the build with the broken roads.  It's the summer sale.  Our goal is to make sure all of the people buying the game have an enjoyable experience. We decide the best decision is to fix the reported bugs and hope that's the last of. We celebrate, job well done!

July 1 : Things seem ok, could it be true? I take a nap. It's my wife's birthday, we have a nice lunch. When we get back, there are more bug reports... And we're still working on them now.

What could we have done better?

We already have a couple of freelancers helping us with QA, but apparently that isn't enough.  Every single one of you plays the game differently so it's impossible for a couple of QA testers to figure out all the different ways you might break the game. 

We will take the following week to resolve the issue.

Then we'll do what we should have been doing from the start, load a build of the game to another branch where people who are willing to help playtest the most recent builds can help us find the bugs before we release it to a wider audience.

To everyone who bought the game and had a bad experience, please accept my most sincere apologies.  If you want to get the game during the summer sale, I would advise you to be prepared for the possibility of bugs. And if you'd rather say away for now, I would totally understand.

Thanks again to everyone who's given us a chance, we will do our best not to mess things up again.

Last month we focused qite heavily on mods, having added Localization and the ability to upload your maps.  This month for a change of pace we were able to come out with some new zones!

[h1]Music Room and Science Lab[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448709/a102f7d27dda870178c4ec1915881c47d56b50ee.gif[/img]

We've added the Music Room and the Science Lab to the list of zones that you can now build.  As with the other special rooms, students will use these rooms in their free time and earn additional learning points while they're using the rooms.  

Some of you might think it's weird that students don't use the science lab during science class, and you're absolutely right!  We're still building in the systems to allow students to use these special rooms during class time, and fingers crossed we'll have that for you very soon!

[h1]Build Phase[/h1]

We're going to be making some pretty big changes to how you get new students in the near future, and we wanted to make sure you would have enough time to adjust at the start of the school year.  So starting from now, you will have a build phase at the start of the year that lets you build out stuff before your students come in.  When you're ready to start, click the "Start School Year" button as you did for your first year.

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]

-broken roads should now be fixed
-adjusted accumulating of food crates so tha there is no overflow of crates
-fixed issue where guidance counselor is not working
-students "stuck" in a staff bathroom should now leave the room insead of being stuck.
-fixed issue where a dismantled item disappears but workers keep dismantling forever

[h1]Known Issues:[/h1]

[b]Game Crashing on Launch:[/b]
When starting the school year or when starting a new game, it will sometimes take a while to start on older systems. If the game looks like it's hanging, please give it a minute or two before shutting it down.  This is something we will actively be working on to fix in the future.

[b]Hungry Students don't go to class:[/b]
Students will sometimes not go to class when they are hungry or if there are no sources of food like vending machines or cafeteria. The issue will fix itself on the next day or after a reload. Alternatively you can try building vending machines to alleviate the food problem.

notes.title: Update 0.2.27 Localization Mods
notes.content:
Hey everyone, as previously mentioned we were also working on adding a localization mod tool to the game.  This means that you can now localize the game into your own language and share it with other players that speak your language! 

[h1]Click and drag to build multiple items[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448709/6acb2fcc2b9fad7ed4099256ca6656375b4cee4f.gif[/img]

Before we get into that though, I want to mention that we also addressed something that folks have been asking for, which is to be able to click and drag objects when building! Okay, now that's out of the way, let's get to using language mods.

[h1]How to install a language mod[/h1]

[u]Subscribe[/u]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448709/ef076bec313213a2af622a0028ec21e1a53a02eb.jpg[/img]

1. Go to the settings menu and click on the language mod. This will bring you the language tab in the mods panel (alternatively from the main screen you can simply click on the mods panel and click on the language tab)
2. The available language mods should now load and display in the panel.
3. Subscribe to the language that you like by clicking the plus button. Wait for it to download 100%. 

[u]Install[/u]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448709/b313368e47cbadc98948a973c0ad2958d096b449.jpg[/img]

1. After the language mod has downloaded 100%, click on Subscribed tab on the mods panel. This will list all the mods that you're subscribed to, including the language mods found at the lower half of the panel. Note that you can only tick only one language at a time.
2. Click on the Apply button at the bottom of the panel. The game will ask you to restart the game. Click Yes. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448709/c467c167d911970a5bc2b24d1733991ac5b2439f.jpg[/img]

tl:dr we're doing our best to fix it as soon as possible,but in the meantime your games should work as normal, just with ugly roads.

notes.title: Update 0.2.22 Sharing Maps and UI fixes
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448709/3237acc78a406c78e90efbb71298a8882597af49.gif[/img]

Hey everyone, we're back with another update at the end of the month.  As mentioned in the last update, content updates have slowed down because we're focusing this month on adding some more things for you guys to mod, fixing some UI issues, and designing for some larger updates in the future.

[h1]Upload your maps[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448709/9a57b10a27e7c283fb3c7062a9d7f005e2e5b890.jpg[/img]

This month we're pleased to announce that you can now upload your maps to steam workshop! We know this is something you all have been requesting for a long time, so we're happy to finally be able to share this with you.  We're also looking forward to seeing your schools!

[h1]How to download a map[/h1]

Map or school mods are just like any other mods in Steam Workshop. We just placed a separate section for such mods in the game so it's easier to locate them.

Instructions
1. In main menu, click on "Mods".
2. In Mods panel, click on the "Browse Maps" tab. 
3. When you find a map you want to download, click on the plus sign to subscribe. The map will now be downloaded.
4. When the map has been downloaded, click on the Subscribed tab.
5. Find the map, and click on the check button next to it. Click on Apply. You will be ask to restart the game.
6. After restarting the game, on the main menu, click on the load game button.
7. In the Load Game panel, click on the Subscribed tab. You should now see your subscribed map! 

[h1]How to upload a map[/h1]

Uploading your school map to Steam Workshop is super simple, just follow these instructions.

Instructions
1. Start or load a game.
2. While in-game, click on the settings menu.
3. Click on the "Upload Map" button.
4. In the panel that appears, fill in the name and description of your map.
5. Click upload map, then wait for it to be uploaded to Steam.

Notes
1. You can only ever upload one map at a time per game session. This means that if you want to upload two maps while playing the game you need to first go back to the main menu, load up a game, and then upload a new map.
2. After uploading, a mod item representing your map should appear in the Mods panel. However, it doesn't apply right away so wait around 10 minutes to an hour. This item should also appear in the Workshop page of the game on Steam.

[h1]Testing out new grants[/h1]

We've made modification to our grants editor to allow us to be a little more creative with the grants. First off, we're exploring giving you recurring grants that you can use if you want to make some quick cash or to challenge yourself by accepting delinquents into your school.  These are the kids that other schools have given up on, can you give them a second chance?

[h1]UI/UX Improvements[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448709/4c9d9eef7f9adbe553dcbc501c35215fc394fba8.gif[/img]

1) Grants information now integrated into one panel to free up screen space
2) Start School button relocated and redesigned to be more visible
3) When cancelling unbuilt objects on unbuilt floors, the object should be cancelled first, before the floor (clicking and dragging to mass cancel removes all)
4) Added a couple of sound effects that hopefully increases your enjoyment of the game
5) Added a loading screen on start of school year and when loading games because black loading screen can be misleading.
6) Added a panel at the start of the school year explaining the basics of building for our first time players

That's it for this month.  We're hoping to be able to add Localization Mods in the next couple of weeks, and in June we should have at least one new zone!

notes.title: Academia : School Simulator Alpha 2 is here!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448709/92d5236a3efa9a28b62613b9e35d7fdc86dc6d93.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone, we’re super excited to announce that we’re releasing Academia : School Simulator Alpha 2!  We’ve made quite a few updates to the game since we launched Early Access, and we feel like we’ve hit a milestone point in the development of the game. But first, here’s what we’ve been working on since the last update:

[h1]Subject Departments[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448709/a8758c815e5eb564e16c01abfaf0ba31aa0e22e3.gif[/img]

Previously, teachers were assigned to a single class and taught all of the subjects.  This was always meant to be temporary, and with this update you can assign teachers to a specific department that best suits them, and they will travel from class to class to teach. Teachers can now also be assigned to teach through all year levels, or stick to just teaching on year level, giving you more control.

[h1]Scheduling[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448709/3031e385fd849747afb2003172a5623e321e4504.gif[/img]

Scheduling has been a major request since launch, and we’re happy to finally share it with you.  Scheduling was more difficult than we had anticipated, and we had to make some hard design decisions about what made sense for the game.  We didn’t want scheduling to be a chore, so a lot of it has been automated to give you the best scheduling outcome. 
However schedule customization is obviously important, so you now have the ability to control when each year level takes its breaks (lunch and recess).  This way you can be more efficient about the use of your kitchens and canteens.  You can also control how often teachers will shift between subjects, so you have control over how often teachers teach and take breaks.

[h1]Trash management[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448709/eba5f3b42f226fa70c8c12b33e81b2c00a0bd363.gif[/img]

Trash used to never be a problem.  Your one trash dumpster could absorb an infinite amount of trash bags before needing to be emptied out come trash time.  This was never intentional, so now we’ve made it so that trash dumpsters only accept a limited amount of trash bags.  Keep an eye out on your garbage area, because if you don’t you may end up with a huge trash problem!

[h1]New UI[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448709/f85fd7233760922a2eb4762f01afadd37c0d10df.gif[/img]

We’ve made a major overhaul to our UI.  Player experience with our previous UI was not the best, and we believe this updated UI is much better, with less strain on the eyes.

[h1]Added Sound Effects[/h1]

We want the game to be as immersive as possible, and adding ambient sound effects helps with that.  Scroll over classrooms to hear student chatter and toilets to hear them flush.  Some objects now also have sound effects as well, click on them to see what they sound like!

[h1]Adjusted Teacher Subject Knowledge[/h1]

We’ve changed the balance of the teachers so that they are much more specialized in one subject that they used to be, meaning you have to be more careful when picking out your teachers.

[h1]New Title Screen[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448709/f150c97705123e3183ed67fb92d6367ce6a58e99.gif[/img]

It’s surprising what such a small change can make.  Everytime I see our new title screen it makes me smile, and I hope you all share the feeling!

[h1]Customized School Settings[/h1]

We updated our custom logo screen to make it more understandable, and have added the first of many customizeable school settings so that you can tweak the game to suit your playstyle.  Choose from a coed, all girls school or all boys school.  Decide how much money to start with.  Do you want your students to be devils or saints?  How often do you want to cope with sick students?  It’s all up to you!

[h1]Now out for Mac![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448709/27dd180da52dd3f21475a973a61e6303b0404d6c.jpg[/img]

We’ve gotten numerous requests for a Mac version, and it’s finally here!  Fingers crossed there aren’t too many bugs!

[h1]Mass Cancel[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448709/64fa3391ce1c63fb01c8ca8b6ea3679545350d6e.gif[/img]

A quality of life request that has been in our ears since launch!  We're sorry it took so long, but you can now right click and drag to cancel a whole bunch of unbuilt stuff.

[h1]Cloud Saves[/h1]

It’s one of those things that doesn’t seem important (until it is).  We now have cloud saving so you can switch from playing the game on your desktop to your laptop anytime.

[h1]Art Room[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448709/d6a5c8cb68bfb6b2a137bf3b194ae4706203f734.gif[/img]

We've added a new zone called the art room!  students will use the art room in their free time for now, but eventually hey will start using it during their art classes.  Our next zone will likely by the science lab,m so stay tuned for that!

[h1]Numerous Balance Changes and Bug Fixes[/h1]

Game development is a never ending battle against bugs and balancing, especially in Early Access!  This update has been trickier than the previous one because of all the changes that we’ve made.

That’s it for this update, but for those who have been holding off since we launched the game, Here are some of the major additions since launch:

Student Delinquency – students now exhibit a range of bad behaviors including bullying and rowdiness in class.
School Monitors – catches delinquent students
Guidance Counselors – counsel delinquent students 
Principal – Disciplines delinquent students and sends them to detention or counseling
Detention Room – Delinquent students go to detention after class
New Walls, Floors, and Decorative items
New School Seal icons
Faculty Lounge – Teachers now have a place to chill and drink coffee
Prestige and School Ranking – can you make it to number 1 in the school rankings?
Zone Merging – make your zones any shape you want!
Janitor and Monitor Routing – Lay down routes to make your staff more efficient

[h1]IMPORTANT[/h1]

This is a major update so your old save WILL NOT WORK.  If you still want to play your old save you can use the outdated branch.

To access the Outdated Branch :

1) Go to your game library and right click on Academia School Simulator
2) In the pop up window, find and click on Properties.
3) In the properties window, click on the Betas Tab
4) Under Enter beta access code to unlock private betas type :
academiaoutdated
5) Click on "check code"
6) Under "Select the beta you would like to opt into" click on the dropdown
menu and click on "outdated"
7) You should now have access to the outdated build

notes.title: Update Adding Guidance Counselor, Truancy, New Faculty Lounge, Grants, and UI Improvements (Build 0082)
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448709/04ca010a51eae4a42f5f7ff2d4be10cb95059404.gif[/img]

Hey everyone we're back with a (slightly delayed) update to the game! Build 0082 brings a couple of new zones, grants, more delinquent behaviors, grants and more!

[h1]Guidance Counselor[/h1]

This is something a lot of you have been waiting for, so we're happy to finally announce the guidance counselor!  Previously in the game, the principal would scold a delinquent student and then send them to detention at the end of the day, but now the principal may decide to send them to counseling.  If scheduled for counseling, a student with free time during lunch or recess will go to the guidance counselor for a session.  After many sessions of working through their anger and digging into their relationship with their parents, a delinquent student will become "cured", or at least learn to behave better in school.

Here's a tip, you can actually hire more than one guidance counselor, in case you have money to burn and A LOT of delinquent students.

[h1]Cutting Class and Truancy[/h1]

We've added some more delinquent behaviors to the game, and now you may have students that skip classes and just hang out around the school, and students that will straight up try to leave your school. Monitors and fencing become much more important now if you wanna keep your delinquent students in line.

That pretty much closes up our delinquency mechanics.  We may add some more delinquent behaviors like smoking or vandalism for your students to indulge in, but for the most part it's a complete system that we're happy with.

[h1]Faculty Lounge[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448709/601d1bcf7886a2182b87a93c781e65d5ec19cd09.gif[/img]

The old faculty lounge has been given an update.  Where previously it looked more like an additional office for the teachers, we have updated it to make it a place where faculty can rest, relax, and get a cup of coffee and read the newspaper!  Faculty will go here when they need to recharge from teaching a bunch of rabid anim...er students.

[h1]New Grants[/h1]

We have a bunch of new grants to keep you occupied!  I was going to mention them here, but maybe it's better to find them out for yourselves in the game. :)

[h1]UI/UX Improvements[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448709/d0804fe4fb8e3a44d4be5949a8edfbbaffd39217.gif[/img]

These students look like they're rioting, but actually they just had no way to get in the school!  We noticed that certain bugs people were reporting actually had to do with a lack of critical information in the UI.  So in the example above to help you understand whats going on, if you scroll over a student it will show the student thinking "nowehere to go!" which is a signal that something is blocking their entrance to the school.  Other UI/UX fixes re below:

- We now show the staff/teacher salary when you fire them, so you can be even more of a calculating capitalist when you fire your hard working employees.

- Objects that have daily water and electricity costs will now show those in the object info panel, so you can decide whether it's REALLY worth it to buy those extra toilets.

- The zone menu is now tabbed, so it's more like the Build and Objects menu (expect much bigger changes to these in the future, as I know it's not particularly good UI)

- Camera will now pan when the cursor hits the edge of the screen

Balance Changes[/h1]

We've made some balance changes to the number of delinquent students that will pop up in the game, as well as som changes to dirt and health.

[h1]Bugs Fixed[/h1]

- Prestige should no longer fluctuate

- Different Classroom, Toilet, and Cafeteria Zone types should now no longer overlap (previously you could overlap a freshman and senior classroom zone, etc.)
- Fixed bug where seniors do not appear on cashflow list
- Fixed bug where student waits for principal even though the principal is not doing anything
- Fixed bug where truant does not go to principals office
- fixed bug where students were not going to detention after class
- fixed bug where cooks would not wash dishes
- Fixed bug where students are stuck in lower right hand corner of the screen
- Fixed bug where different classroom year zones overlap
- Fixed bug where wrong average grade was being given at end of year
- Fixed bug where save files would not load while in-game

To make sure this build is safe, we will be uploading it to the Candidate build first.  The Current build will still be build 0075, which was updated in December.

If scheduled for counseling, a student with free time during lunch or recess will go to the guidance counselor for a session.  After many sessions of working through their anger and digging into their relationship with their parents, a delinquent student will become "cured", or at least learn to behave better in school.

The biggest addition this month is Prestige. Prestige is a new resource/score that you accumulate throughout the game.  From the beginning of development we knew that prestige would be a huge part of the game, especially since many schools live and die based on how "prestigious" they 
are.  Prestige will be an integral part of the game and we will explore many different facets of prestige in the future. For example, your prestige and school ranking will eventually affect the number of student admissions each year. But as of now, here are some of the effects of prestige in the game.

[h1]School Evaluation and School Ranking[/h1]

In addition to being graded at the end of the school year, you will also be given rewards or penalties in the form of prestige and money.  These all add up, and should provide some more challenge to the game.

School ranking is a big new addition that we hope will challenge you guys.  Right now this school ranking is static with only 20 ranks, but in the near future we will have the schools randomly generated and change their ranks at the end of the school year. notes.title: Rolling Back Default Build to 0064 and Moving Build 0070 to Candidate Branch
notes.content:
Hey everyone, there's no getting around it, we done fucked up.  Some of you might have noticed that jacksepticeye did a video on Academia : School Simulator.  That boosted our player base, and we wanted to make sure that the large influx of new players had a better experience by pushing out a balance update.  Unfortunately what seemed like a simple update introduced a whole new set of unforeseen issues like the game refusing to launch and crashing for various reasons.  We've been spending the past couple of days trying to sort out those issues, but in the end we realized it's gonna take a lot longer than we expected.  So we're going to make some changes to the builds.

In retrospect, we already had a system where we pushed our changes to a candidate branch first for testing before releasing the default build to everyone else.  That's what we should have done, and that's what we're doing now. So we're rolling back the default build to build 0064, and moving the latest build 0070 to the candidate branch.  What does this mean for you?

[h1]If you are playing build 0064:[/h1]

Build 0070 game saves will no longer work, but older saves should be fine.

You will also lose these balance updates:
- Lowered delinquency probability for students
- Lowered probability of students making dirt
- Students get more food from eating
- Increased movement for students, teacher, and janitor
- Janitor will now come to school earlier, and leave school much more later in the day
- Increased temporary discipline bonus delinquents get from being scolded by the principal to lessen repeat instances of rowdiness and bullying.

[h1]To access the Candidate Branch on Steam (which should now have build 70):[/h1]

1) Go to your game library and right click on Academia School Simulator
2) In the pop up window, find and click on Properties.
3) In the properties window, click on the Betas Tab
4) Under Enter beta access code to unlock private betas type :
academiacandidate
5) Click on "check code"
6) Under "Select the beta you would like to opt into" click on the dropdown
menu and click on "candidate"
7) You should now have access to the latest candidate build

There will always be issues like this in Early Access games, but clearly this is something that we had control over. We humbly apologize to anyone whos game experience was ruined by our mistake.  It breaks our hearts when we hear that someone's first experience with our game is of it simply refusing to launch and just crashing. In the future, we will be more careful when updating the builds to make sure that you no longer have to experience these issues. Hope you guys understand, and look forward to a new build at the end of the month!

notes.title: Happy Holidays and Q1 2018 plans
notes.content:
Hey everyone, just wanted to write you all a short message thanking each and everyone of you for supporting us in the first few months of Early Access.  It's been a learning process for us at Squeaky Wheel, and while it has been a little rough at times, I think we are finally starting to get a good rhythym.  It has really been humbling for us to see how much you guys are invested in the game, and really inspires us to keep working hard on the game.

I know that some of you are impatient.  You see all the possibilities that the game might become and you can't wait to get there.  We're impatient too, and that's why we're in the process of signing on a couple of developers to help us improve the game at a much quicker pace.  You guys are the reason we could afford to hire on more help, so for that you have our gratitude.

That said, I have to beg your patience again in the coming month.  Starting January, we will start the onboarding process as we loop in our new developers and Marnel catches them up on the code in the game.  That, along with bugfixing, will probably take up most of January.  We're gonna try to see if we can add the Guidance Counselor by end of January, but no promises!  If all goes well, starting February we will be running at full blast.

Once the Guidance Counselor has been added that will finish the first major mechanic added to the game! When we're done we will release a new poll for you all to vote on. While we may not always reply on the discussion board, rest assured that we are keeping an eye on the comments and using them as the basis for what to prioritize in the game. 

Lastly, I'd like to make a small request of you all.  Tagging the game and upvoting current tags helps get Academia : School Simulator in front of people who might be interested in it.  We'd definitely appreciate it if you could tag the game for us based on what you think is appropriate.

Thanks again guys.  We hope you have great holiday season, and we're looking forward to working on the game with you all in 2018!

notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448709/8922f965a271210927e5d7972284f37e725d1934.gif[/img]
Hey Everyone we're back with a final update for 2017!  First things first, we've added a new staff, the Monitor.  Right now the Monitor acts as a deterrent for bullying.  If a monitor spots a bully in the halls of the school, they'll drag the bully all the way to the principal's office to be told off!

In the future the Monitor will also keep an eye out for truants and possibly other bad behavior (any suggestions?).  The Monitor's standard behavior is to patrol the cafeteria, but you can also route the Monitor to check out specific areas for bullying.

[b]NOTE:[/b] Bullying may be unbalanced at the moment, so let us know what you think and we'll adjust the balancing as soon as we can.

[h1]Traits[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448709/bdf94c0b6c81ba70f9b2c9601456b44375a4c301.jpg[/img]

To aid in identifying delinquent students, we've added some UI changes to identify them.  Delinquent students will now be tinted red, and if you click them to open the student profile, you'll see there is now a new classification called "traits".  For now, traits only mark out delinquent students, but in the future students will acquire both positive and negative traits.

[h1]Build Tabs[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448709/72f0182edf6a15327be2914942a4ac87ced77515.gif[/img]

notes.title: New Update Featuring Delinquency! (Build 0057)
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448709/0c5d3cbc011a6602244a5517a7f6478ad086fc9d.gif[/img]

Hey everyone,  we got reports that there were some critical bugs with build 0053, so we had to push this one out earlier than we hoped.  

The plus side is that the first major mechanic has been added to the game : Delinquency!  Students will now randomly generate a tendency for delinquency, and you won't know it until they start acting out in class.  Rowdy students will get sent to the principal's office, where the principal will give them a proper scolding and send them to detention.  

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448709/2591d88dd94a8bf74c19d3e163e2a49d87e46617.gif[/img]

Speaking of which, you can now select some of your classrooms to turn them into a detention room.  Students will go there after school to learn to be better citizens (or not).

Obviously there's still a lot of work to do with delinquency, like adding bullying, truancy, and guidance counselors, but most of the underlying work is now in place so that we can add those to the game in the following weeks.

Since we pushed this out early, there will be bugs!  Many bugs!  We will put this in both the candidate branch and the main branch.  

[h1]To access the Candidate Branch on Steam:[/h1]

1) Go to your game library and right click on Academia School Simulator
2) In the pop up window, find and click on Properties.
3) In the properties window, click on the Betas Tab
4) Under Enter beta access code to unlock private betas type : academiacandidate
5) Click on "check code"
6) Under "Select the beta you would like to opt into" click on the dropdown menu and click on "candidate"
7) You should now have access to the latest candidate build
 
If you would like to keep playing your old saves from build 0049 and below, we have also added an "outdated" build. 

To access this build simply follow the instruction above but instead enter beta access code "academiaoutdated" and  select the "outdated" build in teh dropdown menu.

[h1]Changelog:[/h1]

Features

Added Principal Staff
Added Office Zone(Used by admin, ie by Principal)
Students get rowdy
Teachers send rowdy students to principal
Principals scold student and may send them to dentention
Make classrooms detention rooms
Detention rooms now add a cost to cashflow

Updates

Principal (Office) Zone now required for Basic Education Grant

Bugs fixed

(Critical)
We had many reports of save files not being loaded on build 0053.  This new build should fix those issues

notes.title: New Update Featuring Routing! (Build 0049)
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448709/c34766a87ae480d89c3c3e473aa54b5f7d5c9ad8.gif[/img]

Hi folks, this update features Routing!  Routing allows you to define areas where your staff should focus on, ideally making them more efficient.  Routing took some time to finish but will be very useful in future updates, including security staff than can patrol the halls for delinquent students.

We apologize if this update isn't quite as meaty as you might have hoped.  We are actively looking to hire staff locally (IRL, not in the game!) to help Marnel program the game and get more updates and features out to you much faster.

[h1] Features:[/h1]

- Janitor Routing - players can now set the routes janitors will take. Janitor routing can be accessed through the routing button, and selecting janitor routing. Janitors will follow the path, and clean dirt and trash within their range of vision. Here is a quick explanation of how it works:

Creating Routes - There are two kinds of routes, U-turn:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448709/5be969418555ed3374ab86ab782f47c84a9e3d09.gif[/img]

and Circuit:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448709/0fb2b42392d079f8287cab33057812eb2d3f736b.gif[/img]


Completing a route - To complete a route either click on the complete route button or click on either the FIRST or LAST waypoint to create either a circuit or a U-turn route, based on context.

Editing Routes:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448709/a8cc205deeb79eb5720b8f59d4412c718a0d75ae.gif[/img]

Deleting Routes:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448709/e4db4220a9ece46fd5bbf73de1cd5ba7e0e38758.gif[/img]

[h1] Bugs Fixed:[/h1] 

- Checkbox should not appear for mods which have not yet been downloaded. (fixed by having a checkbox only appear once the mod is downloaded)

- Zone edit no longer highlight zone colors. (fixed by having zones highlight in their colors when in zone edit mod)
- Student still come after starting a new game(transferees). (fixed by not applying settings in transferees panel from a previous game)
- Firing a worker before they build an object and no worker will take over the task. (fixed by having a new worked assigned to the task)
- Staff move behind mounted clocks. (fixed by having staff rendered above mounted clocks)


[h1] Miscellaneous:[/h1] 

 - Day/Night Cycle - The screen will now get darker as time progresses into the later parts of the day.
- Added Double doors
- More women special teachers!
- Common Area - The club zone is now called the common area.  
- Update button for subscribed mods -  Subscribed mods will have an update button if there are any updates to the mod.

Important: If you have made a mod that changed the characters in the game, please update your mod to include the new teachers in the characters.png file.

notes.title: Academia: School Simulator is like Prison Architect but with kids
notes.content:
I'd like to blame my school's layout on poor planning, but that would assume there was any planning at all. As I do in every other game where you build stuff, I just sort of built stuff, which is why children arrive to start their lessons by walking through an area designated for garbage and winding up directly beside another area designated for garbage. Will these fresh-face tots feel their hearts swell with school pride when they walk in the front door each morning and are greeted by the sight of a janitorial closet, a bathroom, another bathroom, and a third bathroom?

I'm here to find out. I've been playing Academia: School Simulator, which is now in Steam Early Access. It looks a lot like Prison Architect (Ryan Sumo, PA's artist, co-founded Squeaky Wheel, which is developing Academia) and it plays a lot like Prison Architect, too. Everything from the art to the UI to the building and management systems are extremely reminiscent of Prison Architect, except your building is full of kids instead of prisoners—though it's not difficult to draw some parallels between public education and incarceration.

Beginning with just some grassy terrain and a handful of expectant workers, I lay down tile floors, build brick walls, and zone for classrooms, a cafeteria, and a kitchen. I initially forget to put in bathrooms, though I'm sharp enough to notice that my students keep running outside to pee in the bushes. Let the trauma and embarrassment of school life begin!

I add the required fittings for each room: desks and chalkboards, toilets and sinks, fridges and ovens, tables and chairs. There's no power lines or water piping to deal with (at the moment at least), so you just plunk something down and it works. I hire staff members: teachers, custodians, cooks, and a few extra laborers.

Kids come to school, they mill around in areas like the 'club' room or computer lab, they go to class (in fact, oddly, they get there before the teachers do). They track dirt everywhere, they leave litter lying in the hallways, they complain about being hungry or bored. Especially hungry. After a few days pass I notice kids are sitting in class thinking about burgers, and then they go to the cafeteria and think about burgers, and then they go back to class where they think about burgers. I glance at a kid using the toilet. His thought is: burgers.

Clearly something is wrong, and not just the fact that I'm sitting here watching a high school freshman take a dump while reading his mind. It looks like my cooks aren't cooking and there are food deliveries piling up outside. I fire my cooking staff, replace them, but everyone in the school is still thinking burgers without ever getting any burgers. Finally, I check the Steam forums which say it's a known bug and restarting the game may help. Once I restart, the kitchen staff hops to, brings in food, cooks it, and serves it. The kids go back to thinking about science and books.

I continue building, adding more classrooms to accommodate a crowd of transfer students, I rezone some rooms for sophomores, juniors, and seniors, and I add a statue at the school's entrance which I hope will pull the eye away from two large garbage areas that I can't be bothered to relocate. I build a place for the faculty to hang out and commiserate over their low pay, and I'm even kind enough to take a moment to rescue the school medical staff, several workers, and two teachers who have been trapped in a wing of the school I forgot to build doors on.

Despite my various blunders, my school remains profitable for the most part. I've satisfied the requirements of all the grants available (as in Prison Architect, these are little challenges that earn you additional money), and I've currently got 80 students on my way to 100, once I build a few more classrooms (hopefully at least a couple with doors on them). My kids aren't especially thrilled with my school, but apart from littering and having impure burger-related thoughts, they're all behaving.

At this point in Academia's development, it doesn't feel like there's much depth to the simulation, but I'm going to keep my eye on this game. I love Prison Architect, and If enough layers are added to Academia it could be as interesting and compelling a game as PA, though I'm also hoping Squeaky Wheel has plans to distinguish themselves from Introversion's prison sim with some new and different gameplay systems. It's off to an enjoyable start, anyway.

Academia: School Simulator is in Early Access on Steam. It's also got an official site where you can follow its development. Just finish your homework first.

notes.title: New Build Up! (Build 37)
notes.content:
Hi guys! We have our first update since release. For this update, we've worked on some of the bugs and minor features reported by players on the discussion boards, and some balancing tweaks.

Changelog:

- Balancing updates for food need. Food should now decrease slower with time.
- Balancing updates for hygiene need. Hygiene now decreases when, eating, using toilet, walking on non floor tiles, and walking on dirty tiles.
- Separate school bell volume settings in settings menu.
- New carpet,wooden and brick floor tiles.
- Players can now select what student year level when creating a classroom zone.
- Players can now select what kind of toilet when creating a toilet zone.
- Students should now only urinate on bushes when there are no toilets of the same gender.
- Workers should now be able to enter toilets regardless of gender
- Floors can now be built on top of existing floors
- Health states should now reset at end of school year
- Hotkey for zoom in and zoom out using '-' and '+' now available
- Players will now get an emergency loan up reaching negative funds
- Tables should not block characters
- Janitors should not leave dirt as they leave a tile
- All UI panels should have 100% alpha
- Layout menu renamed to blueprint 


Bugs fixed:

- Fixed bug in which players experience skipping school days
- Fixed cook not collecting dishes
- Fixed cook not cooking
- Fixed cook not going to kitchen when there are no more tasks
- Fixed a bug in which blueprint outlines removed vegetation
-  Fixed a bug in which walls connect with doors and object blue prints
- Fixed a bug in which funds became unlimited when starting a non sandbox game


Your current save files will still work but the game data tweaks may not take effect because the game loads the ones from the file. Some of the game tweaks are only applied to newly generated NPCs. If your save file no longer works, please report it to us together with the save file through the bug report form. We'll check it right away.
